description: This is a test class for the ConceptSourceValidator in the org.openmrs.validator package, containing JUnit 5 test methods for validating various fields of ConceptSource objects.

classes.name: ConceptSourceValidatorTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the validation logic of ConceptSourceValidator in the context of OpenMRS.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfNameIsNullOrEmptyOrWhitespace
methods.description: Tests that validation fails when the name field is null, empty, or whitespace.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfDescriptionIsNullOrEmptyOrWhitespace
methods.description: Tests that validation fails when the description field is null, empty, or whitespace.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassValidationIfHl7CodeIsNullOrEmptyOrWhitespace
methods.description: Verifies that validation passes when HL7 code is null, empty, or whitespace.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassValidationIfAllRequiredFieldsHaveProperValues
methods.description: Ensures validation passes when all required fields have valid values.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassValidationIfFieldLengthsAreCorrect
methods.description: Checks that validation passes when field lengths are within acceptable limits.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfFieldLengthsAreNotCorrect
methods.description: Tests that validation fails when fields exceed maximum length constraints.
